messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SLO ALERT: Latency p99 elevated for service=runtime-api region=us-west1. p95=420ms p99=1.6s. SLO burn 45% over 10m. Auto-page enabled.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-84231 triggered and notified on-call. Priority: P1.

olivia: acked. i'm on it — looking at hotspots and autoscaler health. grabbing traces.

chris: seeing a burst of KV cache thrash and higher CPU on pool-gpu-3. requests spike from a customer integration job.

raj: any errors? or just latency?

olivia: mostly tail latency, 503s remain low. traces show heavy token generation for long-sequence requests (seq_len ~ 2k). batching/backpressure looks ok but kv cache miss ratio up to 38%.

maria: customers that hit p99 — any high-value tenants? we need impact list for comms.

chris: checking shard routing: a single tenant (acme-marketing) seems to be hitting large batches. their qps jumped 5x from their scheduled export.

olivia: recommended immediate mitigation: 1) throttle that tenant at edge rule, 2) toggle fallback to lower-memory model variant, 3) scale up dedicated pool. which is fastest?

raj: fastest path is throttling at the api-gateway rule. can apply a soft rate-limit for the tenant key. code: ```curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/rl -d '{"tenant":"acme-marketing","limit":50}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN'```

maria: go for throttling now. i'll prepare customer note if we need to extend.

olivia: throttling applied (edge rule id: r-7f2). verified reduced sustained qps from that tenant. p99 dropped to 980ms at 02:19 UTC, p95=360ms. SLO burn back down to 12% over 10m.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty INC-84231 acknowledged by olivia.

chris: autoscaler shows pending upscales but new nodes are slow to spin due to quota limits in us-west1. we can hot-add from us-central if routing allows.

raj: fallback: route 10% of traffic to us-central pool with compatible model tag `rwd-13b-quant`. update routing rule:```PATCH /routing/api/v1/route
{
  "match": "model:rwd-13b,region:us-west1",
  "split": "90,10",
  "dest": "us-west1,us-central"
}```

olivia: doing a canary 10% shift now. monitoring.

(30s later)

olivia: canary 10% active. p99 now at 650ms global, p95 310ms. kv miss ratio trending down. no customer-facing errors observed.

maria: confirmed high-risk customers notified: acme-marketing ops contacted and briefed on temporary throttling. they asked for ETA — can we give an hour?

olivia: ETA ~ 45–60m to stabilize fully once autoscaler finishes warmup. we'll monitor telemetry and update.

chris: logged follow-up: need a throttling policy to auto-detect long-sequence jobs and route them to batch-tier. filed ENGRTC-1194.

raj: handoff: i'm on-call for next shift in 30m. olivia, if this keeps trending we'll need to escalate to infra for quota bump or migrate some reserved capacity.

olivia: noted. i'll create bridge notes and tag infra if autoscale stalls. adding runbook checklist:
```
- confirm tenant throttled
- verify p99 < 1s
- check autoscaler queue
- confirm routing split and canary stability
- contact top 5 affected customers
- prepare rollback path (remove canary split)
```

pagerduty-bot: INC-84231 update: status=investigating -> mitigated (partial). acknowledged by olivia.

maria: thanks team. keep updates in thread. i'll draft a short status we can push to support.

olivia: leaving a note for next oncall: if p99 climbs above 1.2s again, escalate to on-call infra and consider emergency quota allocation.

chris: adding perf graphs and trace links: https://observability.redwood/internal/trace/84231 and dashboard https://dashboards.redwood/slo/runtime-p99?range=15m

olivia: last check at 02:23 UTC: p99=590ms p95=300ms. setting reminder to re-evaluate at +30m.

raj: ack handoff. i'll monitor, and will call infra if autoscaler doesn't finish by 03:00 UTC.

incident-bot: Incident thread closed for now. If latency recurs, new page will be created per the autoscale/paging policy. :white_check_mark:
